Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

I played · I went
FormPastExample
regular+ edplay → I played football.
spelling-ied / -ppedstudy → studied
irregularlearn thesego → went, see → saw
to bewas / wereIt was fun. They were happy.
  • Regular verbs: add -ed. play → played, watch → watched, work → worked. I played football.
  • Spelling: study → studied, live → lived, stop → stopped.
  • Irregular (learn these): go → went, see → saw, have → had, eat → ate, meet → met.
  • Recycled: was / were for 'to be'. It was fun. They were happy. Time: yesterday, last weekend, last year.

★ This is the last lesson — you're ready for A1! Keep telling your stories.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: play → playED (add -ed). Irregular verbs change the word: go → WENT, eat → ATE.
  • ⚠ Вчера / кеше + verb-ed: I playED football. Learn the irregular ones by heart: went, ate, saw.

🔊 A true story — Oxford Navigate audiolisten, then answer
1Julio Diaz was in a train station.
2The boy had a knife.
3Diaz gave the boy his wallet.
4Diaz called the police.
5They went to a restaurant together.
6The boy gave Diaz all the money back.
7Diaz gave the boy $20.
8Diaz was angry with the boy.
Why these answers

Julio Diaz gave the boy his wallet and jacket, then took him to a restaurant. In the end the boy gave the money back and Diaz gave him $20.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write your first story: three past lines about last weekend.

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

Last weekend I went to the park. I played football with my friends and we ate pizza. It was a great day!

Check yourself:

  • Did you use past verbs (played, went, ate)?
  • Did you use was / were?
  • Three short lines — a beginning, a middle, an end?
